(subtle)'). The join between two pieces of a short, montage, match reel or impact-play reel. Read by services/clip/reel_transition.py and services/studio-ui/user-settings.mjs (Settings > Clips). The user's choice is settings.json clips.reelTransition {kind, ms}. Behind the flag reel-transitions (off by default). More kinds: add a row with an ffmpeg xfade transition name; no code change.
approved: user 2026-11-11 chose the feature and a subtle cross fade to start; the length range and default are the agent's proposal (plan RP1)

kinds.label: Cut
kinds.about: Hard cut with a short audio fade (as before).

kinds.label: Cross fade
kinds.about: The next piece fades in over the last moment of the one before; the sound crossfades. Each join makes the reel this much shorter.

setsComment: FX3 (D411): transition sets of the clip look (data/clip/look.json, Settings > Clips > Clip look). Each join of a reel draws one ffmpeg xfade kind from its set (seeded, weighted, never the same kind twice in a row). Joins marked flash change the whole picture's brightness (fade through white or black); two of them are never closer than minFlashGapSec, so a reel stays far under 3 flashes per second. Sound effects are made on this PC (reel_sfx.py), peak at sfxDb under full scale, and are not ducked. beatSync moves a join up to maxBeatShiftSec earlier onto the music's beat (a piece's tail is trimmed, never its kill).
